title: Find which lint step hangs and kill its whole process group
why: [00:43 CST Nov 16, triage] Coordinator relay 00:44 CST, on the consultant's word (his 00:44 CST message). Evidence: runner 10's lint of #2917 hung twice in the "Debt retire fixture suite" (silent 28 min; stopped at 00:38 CST); the consultant's lint of #3362 died at its 65-minute limit at 00:40 CST on the cloud host (node v22.23.4; his log parse could not name the hung step). The archive-flow lane reports the suite passes in 3.9 s (58 tests) on its own host at #2917's head, and proposes a process-group kill at lint/check_debt_retire.py:140 (not applied). Scope: find the hung step with `pgrep -l` or `ps -ef --forest` during a stall, then a process-group kill per step. It touches a check, so the build goes to a builder with a reviewer. Related steps, none the same: ready-step-hang-no-timeout (progress lines in the debt-close lint; lane of #3400), time-limits-end-hangs-only (#2863, stop on silence), ready-checks-time-bound (#3423, a time bound per check in merge --ready). Searched steps and rulings for lint-step-hang and the suite name before filing.
